name: Convergence Funnel
intent: Build a self-correcting reverse funnel component for MOOR. After the forward funnel produces a result, preserve the original description as immutable dogfood. Observe the actual result without showing the observer the target, then apply the original description to that neutral observation. Classify every material difference as missing, wrong, or extra. Convert only those differences into the smallest delta spec, patch the artifact, observe again, and repeat until no material difference remains. Promotion must fail closed: no proxy evidence, partial gate, buffer count, or implementation claim may substitute for the observable result that the requirement describes. Preserve iteration history, proof scope, artifact identity, and the original dogfood. Make it reusable by an LLM without requiring prior-chat memory, and register it in Project Pulse as a component.

parts.job: compile the original dogfood into explicit requirements once
observe the actual artifact without target leakage and state the evidence boundary
compare observed consequence to immutable dogfood and classify missing / wrong / extra
emit only the smallest next patch; never regenerate working unrelated systems
fail closed until no material difference remains
preserve artifact identity, proof scope, and iteration history
append every accepted iteration as original intent → Funnel interpretation → observed result with scoped assessor estimate

requirements: CF-02 forward blueprint precedes reverse loop
CF-03 observer is blind to target
CF-04 actual observation is compared to original dogfood
CF-05 differences are missing / wrong / extra
CF-06 next job is minimal delta only
CF-07 repeat observe → difference → delta until none
CF-09 proxy evidence cannot escape its observation boundary
CF-10 artifact identity / proof scope / history survive each iteration
CF-11 explicit worker packet makes prior-chat memory unnecessary
CF-13 accepted iterations append compatible Trajectory checkpoints without mutating earlier history

wrong: CF-07 — loop existed but was not sufficiently explicit in the observed consequence

delta: Require an explicit observation modality and evidence-boundary field before comparison can run.
Carry modality and evidence boundary in the iteration record and worker contract.
Make the repeat-until-none loop explicit in the observable artifact.

iteration2.boundary: Structural self-audit only; arbitrary perceptual equivalence still requires a blind observer in the artifact's modality.

failurePolicy: UNVERIFIED, PARTIAL, wrong-modality evidence, artifact mismatch, missing evidence boundary, or material difference blocks promotion
